newsitem.title: USA: FP&L St Lucie Florida nuke trips off line.
newsitem.headline: FP&L St Lucie Florida nuke trips off line.

text.p: Florida Power and Light Co's (FP&L) 839 megawatt (MW) St Lucie 1 nuclear power plant tripped off line Tuesday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
"Unit one did trip off line early this afternoon. There was a vibration in a reactor coolant pump," said NRC spokesman Roger Hannah.
He did not have an estimated restart time for the unit and FP&L officials were not immediately available for comment.
The St Lucie power station is at Hutchinson Island, Fla.
The adjacent unit, St Lucie 2, also rated at 839 MW, was reported by the NRC early Tuesday to be running at full output.
Local temperatures in the region were reported in the high 80s F, indicating there would likely be some air conditioning demand in the region.
Florida Power and Light is a subsidiary of FPL Group Inc.
